rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for saying that someone or something also does or has something.

example.english: I also want to go eat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dou1 soeng2 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use 仲 when adding another fact or item, especially with a sense of 'in addition' or 'on top of that'.

example.english: This restaurant has main courses and also desserts.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭有正餐，仲有甜品。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 jau5 zing3 caan1 zung6 jau5 tim4 ban2

rows.note: Use 又 for an additional parallel property or action, often in a repeated or paired pattern.

example.english: They are fast and also clever.

rows.note: Use 亦 mainly in formal or written language instead of the everyday spoken choices.

example.english: This plan will also consider environmental factors.
example.traditional: 本計劃亦會考慮環保因素。
example.jyutping: bun2 gai3 waak6 jik6 wui5 haau2 leoi6 waan4 bou2 jan1 sou3
